products.name: Low Tide
products.desc: A set of four coasters poured in layered teal and sand, each one catching the light a little differently — like the shoreline at low tide.

products.name: Amber Vein
products.desc: Deep amber and brass resin poured over a walnut panel, with fine gold veining running through like light through honey.

products.name: Geode Bloom
products.desc: A geode-style pour built up in twelve layers, with crushed glass and gold leaf edging for a piece that looks lit from within.

products.name: Tidepool Tray
products.desc: A serving tray with a poured resin base in cool tidepool tones, sealed under a glass-smooth, food-safe top coat.

products.name: Copper Fracture
products.desc: A hand-cut resin pendant with suspended copper leaf fracture lines, hung on a waxed cotton cord.

products.name: Deep Current
products.desc: Dark, moody blues built in deep layers to mimic the way light disappears the further you go under water.

products.name: Sandbar Set
products.desc: Warm sand tones with a single thread of gold through each piece — a quieter companion to Low Tide.

products.name: Ember Pour
products.desc: A pair of bookends with a warm brick-and-brass pour, weighted and felt-backed to protect shelves.
